summary: multisample_pid.py charge --method likelihood returned the first or last point of --z-range for an event whose likelihood maximum lies outside it, so particles of a charge outside the range were reported at the range's edge, with no warning.

database_specific.introduced_basis: the defective code is in the script as first released (hep-research 0.14.0, commit f7d5722d); the 0.14.0 release already held the file

observables: summary, per_true_z, leakage and toy_prediction of multisample_pid.py charge --method likelihood
impact.bias: events beyond --z-range pile up at its edge: in the audit's case 50 events of Z = 5 with --z-range 0.5 3 were all reported at 3.0 with sigma68 0, so the peak, the width and the leakage matrix are wrong for those charges
impact.trigger: --method likelihood with a --z-range that does not hold the maxima of all events (or toys)

outputs.how_to_recognize: JSON on stdout of multisample_pid.py charge with method likelihood; affected when an estimate equals the first or last scanned value (a per_true_z median at inputs.z_range or a sigma68 of 0 there); outputs of the fixed version carry at_z_range_edge

remedy: rerun multisample_pid.py charge with this version and read at_z_range_edge and the warning; widen --z-range until no event is at its edge
